Discrete semiconductors — the individual diodes and transistors everything else gets built from, as opposed to integrated circuits where dozens to billions of them are fabricated together on one die.

- [Diodes](diodes.qmd)
- [Zener and Schottky diodes](zener-schottky-diodes.qmd)
- [Bipolar junction transistors (BJT)](bjt.qmd)
- [MOSFETs](mosfet.qmd)
- [Thyristors (SCR / TRIAC)](thyristors.qmd)

| Device | Terminals | Controlled by | Typical role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Diode | 2 | — (one-way by construction) | Rectification, protection, reference |
| BJT | 3 | Base current | Amplification, switching |
| MOSFET | 3 | Gate voltage | Switching, power conversion |
| Thyristor | 3 (or 4 leads for TRIAC) | Gate trigger pulse, then latches | AC power control |

More devices (JFETs, IGBTs) may get added here as I work through them.
